lead: The neighbourhood born for the 1992 Games, between the Olympic marina and the Nova Icària beach.
text: This is the part of Poblenou redeveloped to house the athletes of the 1992 Olympic Games, with the aim of modernising the area, and it is regarded as Barcelona's first seafront neighbourhood. Its landmarks include the Port Olímpic, the Nova Icària beach, the Torre Mapfre and the Xavier Benguerel library.

It is a low-density residential neighbourhood by central Barcelona standards, with buildings by architects who won FAD awards. With 10,046 inhabitants/km², it has far fewer people per square kilometre than Poblenou or El Clot, and its average rent, 1,613 €/month, is the second highest in Sant Martí, behind only Diagonal Mar.
housing: Residential buildings from the 1990s, by award-winning architects, beside the sea.
